request.objective: Start at https://www.target.com/. Search for a job in Miami, Florida, in Human Resources on target.

response.result:
Searched Target for **Human Resources** near **Miami, Florida (33101)**, within 25 miles. Target showed **6 results**. The HR-titled opening is **Executive Team Leader Human Resources (Assistant Manager HR) | North Miami, FL**; its listed address is **16901 Miramar Pkwy, Miramar, FL**. It is categorized as Store Leadership, full-time, with pay of **$64,000–$128,000**.

The other results were three **Target Security Specialist** openings (Hialeah, North Miami Beach, and Hollywood), **Store Executive Intern (Store Leadership Intern) – Miami – Starting Summer 2027** (Miami; part-time), and **General Merchandise Team Leader** (Miramar; full-time; $21.50–$23.50 per hour).
